#test: is relative abundance in the field associated with isolate persistence?
```{r}
abundance<-read.csv("otu_table_for_cooccurence.csv", row.names = 1,header=TRUE)
metadata<-read.csv("netcomi_filtered_nodelist.csv", header=TRUE, row.names = 1)

metadata = metadata[row.names(metadata) %in% row.names(abundance),]
abundance = abundance[row.names(abundance) %in% row.names(metadata),]
abundance <- abundance[rownames(metadata),]
metadata <- metadata[rownames(abundance),]
abundance<-as.matrix(abundance)

set.seed(345)
of2 <- RRPP::lm.rrpp(abundance ~ Persist,
data = metadata, SS.type = "III", print.progress = FALSE, seed = "random", iter = 1000)
 
anova(of2, effect.type = "F")

rel_abund_subsetance <- sweep(abundance, 2, colSums(abundance), "/")
#write.csv(rel_abund_subsetance,"relative_abundance_include_All.csv")

rel_abund<-read.csv("relative_abundance_include_All.csv", row.names = 1,header=TRUE)
rel_abund_subset<-read.csv("relative_abundance_for_heatmap.csv", row.names = 1,header=TRUE)

metadata = metadata[row.names(metadata) %in% row.names(rel_abund_subset),]
rel_abund_subset = rel_abund_subset[row.names(rel_abund_subset) %in% row.names(metadata),]
rel_abund_subset <- rel_abund_subset[rownames(metadata),]
metadata <- metadata[rownames(rel_abund_subset),]
rel_abund_subset<-as.matrix(rel_abund_subset)

set.seed(345)
of3 <- RRPP::lm.rrpp(rel_abund_subset ~ Persist,
data = metadata, SS.type = "III", print.progress = FALSE, seed = "random", iter = 1000)
 
anova(of3, effect.type = "F")
```

#Check the output from Cytoscape including closeness centrality, between centrality, and degree
```{r}
node_list<-read.csv("netcomi_filtered_nodelist.csv", header=TRUE, row.names = 1)
#remove Contaminants and rename ASVs 
node_list<-subset(node_list,Persist != "Contaminant")

Y<-cbind(node_list$Degree,node_list$BetweennessCentrality,node_list$ClosenessCentrality,node_list$Radiality)

man.test<- manova(Y~ Persist,data = node_list)

summary(man.test)
summary.aov(man.test)

post_hoc<-aov(Degree~Persist,data=node_list)
summary(post_hoc)
results<-HSD.test(post_hoc,"Persist",group=TRUE)
print(results$groups)

node_list$Persist<-factor(node_list$Persist,levels=c("Untargeted ASVs","Not Persistent","Persistent"))

plot<-summarySE(node_list,measurevar = "Degree",groupvars =c("Persist"),na.rm=TRUE)

p1<-ggplot(plot, aes(x = Persist, y =Degree)) +
  geom_point(size=3)+
  #scale_fill_manual(values=c42)+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Degree-sd,ymax=Degree+sd))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
  ylab("Degree")+
  xlab("Category")

plot2<-summarySE(node_list,measurevar = "ClosenessCentrality",groupvars =c("Persist"),na.rm=TRUE)

p2<-ggplot(plot2, aes(x = Persist, y =ClosenessCentrality)) +
  geom_point(size=3)+
  #scale_fill_manual(values=c42)+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=ClosenessCentrality-sd,ymax=ClosenessCentrality+sd))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
  ylab("Closeness Centrality")+
  xlab("Category")

plot3<-summarySE(node_list,measurevar = "BetweennessCentrality",groupvars =c("Persist"),na.rm=TRUE)

p3<-ggplot(plot3, aes(x = Persist, y =BetweennessCentrality)) +
  geom_point(size=3)+
  #scale_fill_manual(values=c42)+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=BetweennessCentrality-sd,ymax=BetweennessCentrality+sd))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
  ylab("Betweenness Centrality")+
  xlab("Category")

plot4<-summarySE(node_list,measurevar = "Radiality",groupvars =c("Persist"),na.rm=TRUE)

p4<-ggplot(plot4, aes(x = Persist, y =Radiality)) +
  geom_point(size=3)+
  #scale_fill_manual(values=c42)+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Radiality-sd,ymax=Radiality+sd))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
  ylab("Radiality")+
  xlab("Category")

(p1|p2)/
  (p3|p4)

```
